$description: C2 · Chroma Luminous materials, light. Decoration: every piece has an opaque fallback (prefers-reduced-transparency, prefers-contrast: more, no backdrop-filter) and is removed in forced colours.

overlay.$description: Overlay glass tint: menus, popovers, cards, sticky bars. Checked worst-case over white, black and every fill.

modal.$description: Modal glass tint: dialogs, over the scrim.

blur.$description: Backdrop blur for overlay and modal glass.

contrast.$description: Backdrop contrast() that compresses the range behind glass, so text stays legible.

dome.$description: Glass sheen: the dome of light inside the top edge. Contrast is checked where it overlaps the streak.

streak.$description: Glass sheen: a thin diagonal streak, the reflection of a window.

prism-base.$description: Base pane of a prism (primary) button.

prism-base-active.$description: Base pane of a pressed primary button.

blur.$description: Backdrop blur for buttons outside a glass parent.

sheen.$description: Alpha of the white sheen at the top of a button.

rim-top.$description: Top rim light of a glass button (inset highlight).

rim-bottom.$description: Bottom rim of a glass button.

refract.$description: Light refracted along the lower edge of a glass button.

1.$description: Prism tone 1 of a primary button (aqua), pooled at its base. No orchid next to azure, so no purple-into-blue step.

2.$description: Prism tone 2 of a primary button (citron), pooled at its base. No orchid next to azure, so no purple-into-blue step.

3.$description: Prism tone 3 of a primary button (rose), pooled at its base. No orchid next to azure, so no purple-into-blue step.

4.$description: Prism tone 4 of a primary button (mint), pooled at its base. No orchid next to azure, so no purple-into-blue step.

5.$description: Prism tone 5 of a primary button (amber), pooled at its base. No orchid next to azure, so no purple-into-blue step.

rose.$description: Ambient rose light behind content (checked where text can sit on it, also doubled).

orchid.$description: Ambient orchid light behind content (checked where text can sit on it, also doubled).

iris.$description: Ambient iris light behind content (checked where text can sit on it, also doubled).

azure.$description: Ambient azure light behind content (checked where text can sit on it, also doubled).

aqua.$description: Ambient aqua light behind content (checked where text can sit on it, also doubled).

mint.$description: Ambient mint light behind content (checked where text can sit on it, also doubled).

citron.$description: Ambient citron light behind content (checked where text can sit on it, also doubled).

amber.$description: Ambient amber light behind content (checked where text can sit on it, also doubled).

0.$description: Satin fold 0. Hero text is checked against every fold.

1.$description: Satin fold 1. Hero text is checked against every fold.

2.$description: Satin fold 2. Hero text is checked against every fold.

3.$description: Satin fold 3. Hero text is checked against every fold.

4.$description: Satin fold 4. Hero text is checked against every fold.

chrome.$description: The chrome hairline as conic stops (position = turn). Every stop is a 3:1 boundary; the band near 0.5 is the dispersion.

dispersion.$description: Dispersed light at the lower edge of chrome: amber → citron → mint → aqua → azure.

prism-fill.$description: Multi-tone fill for small controls (checkbox, radio, switch, steps).

prism-ring.$description: Multi-tone ring that replaces chrome on selected and on states; a 3:1 boundary.

metal.$description: Liquid metal for icon tiles and avatars.

bead-on.$description: Switch thumb when on (3:1 against the multi-tone track).

chrome-line.$description: A single chrome stop for straight hairlines (dividers, pull-quote rules). A 3:1 boundary.

chrome-text.$description: Chrome for display text clipped to its glyphs: sky above, a dark horizon, a warm floor below. Every stop reaches 3:1 on canvas as large text.

bg.$description: Field fill: a recessed well in a chrome bezel. Lighter than the choice wells on pearl, so placeholder and hint text keep 4.5:1.

inset.$description: Inset shade at the top of a field.

focus-glow.$description: Optional halo outside the focus outline; dropped in forced colours. Never the focus indicator on its own.

rest.$description: Switch thumb at rest: a lit metal bead (radial, light from the upper left).

rest-rim.$description: Rim of the resting bead. A 3:1 boundary against the track.

lit.$description: Switch thumb when on, as a lit bead (radial). Its solid fallback is material.bead-on.

top.$description: Top rim light of a metal icon tile.

bottom.$description: Bottom rim of a metal icon tile.

top.$description: Top of the glass prism illustration.

bottom.$description: Bottom of the glass prism illustration.

shadow.$description: Shadow under the glass prism illustration.

tile-ink.$description: Icon colour on a metal tile: the chrome stop at 38°.

specular.$description: Specular rim: the bright line where a top edge meets the light (glass, buttons, wells).

sky.$description: Liquid chrome: the sky it reflects, at the top.

high.$description: Liquid chrome: high in the reflection.

mid.$description: Liquid chrome: the middle, where engraved text sits.

horizon.$description: Liquid chrome: the dark horizon band. Light enough that engraved marks keep 3:1.

low.$description: Liquid chrome: just below the horizon.

floor.$description: Liquid chrome: the warm floor it reflects, at the bottom.

rim.$description: Liquid chrome: the dark rim round a chrome ball, its boundary against a lit track (3:1).

engrave.$description: Engraved ink on liquid chrome: ticks and the selected tab or option name (3:1 marks, 4.5:1 text).

engrave-lift.$description: The light catching the lower edge of an engraving.

fill.$description: A recess for choice controls, tabs and the segmented control: off, unselected.

depth.$description: Shadow falling into a recess from its top edge.

lip.$description: Light catching the lip just below a recess, and the inner edge of thick glass.

rose.$description: Light (rose): caustics, pools and glows. Decoration only, never text or a boundary.

amber.$description: Light (amber): caustics, pools and glows. Decoration only, never text or a boundary.

citron.$description: Light (citron): caustics, pools and glows. Decoration only, never text or a boundary.

mint.$description: Light (mint): caustics, pools and glows. Decoration only, never text or a boundary.

aqua.$description: Light (aqua): caustics, pools and glows. Decoration only, never text or a boundary.

azure.$description: Light (azure): caustics, pools and glows. Decoration only, never text or a boundary.

pool.$description: Light (pool): caustics, pools and glows. Decoration only, never text or a boundary.

pool-warm.$description: Light (pool-warm): caustics, pools and glows. Decoration only, never text or a boundary.

core.$description: The specular glint that sweeps across a primary button on hover: its core.

fringe.$description: Thick-glass edges: a specular top rim, cool and warm split colour at the sides as a lens disperses, a warm lower lip and its shadow, and light entering from above. All inside the padding, under no text.

rest.$description: Diffuse prism glow under a primary at rest.

soft.$description: Glow under a hovered neutral button.

critical.$description: Glow under a hovered destructive button.

glass.$description: Glass depth: a bright bevel inside the top, a darker one inside the bottom, the slab's lit side below it, a contact shadow and a long soft one.
